name: experience-ablation-m9-evidence-map
title: Experience-ablation M9: paper-ready claim-to-artifact evidence map with final inconclusive verdict
description: Milestone M9, the final milestone of docs/requirements/decisions/experience-layer-ablation-causal-validation-execution-plan.md. Build a committed evidence-map generator (experiments/experience-ablation/evidence-map.mjs + selfcheck) that emits the paper-ready artifact evidence-map.md + evidence-map.json under the experiment evidence root: (a) a claim-to-artifact table mapping every plan-section-18 definition-of-done row to its concrete artifact (protocol.json + protocolHash, memory-snapshot-hash.json, fixture manifest + pair ledger + sealed run-order seed, leakage-audit.jsonl, score-records.jsonl with replay digest, n-freeze.json refusal verdict, m7-decision.json, live-readout.{json,md}) with per-artifact existence and hash checks; (b) the no-overclaim summary including the circularity disclosure verbatim from plan sections 2/15; (c) the final study summary stating the causal verdict: INCONCLUSIVE — the design assumption (planning-band baseline 0.5-0.8) was invalidated by the pilot measurement (0.0333), the powered study was mechanically unsizable and skipped by explicit decision, and the in-store vs held-out contrast was never powered; (d) a paper-integration section per plan section 16 with the suggested table columns filled from pilot data marked exploratory/unpowered. Exit criteria (plan section 13 M9 row): the paper section can cite protocol, ledger, score records, leakage audit, and analysis report.
